result.stdout:
tps - read-only Clarion TopSpeed file CLI

Usage:
  tps inspect <file-or-directory> [options]
  tps schema <file> [--table <name-or-number>] [options]
  tps rows <file> [query-options]
  tps export <file> --output <directory> [query-options]
  tps --version

Run 'tps <command> --help' for command details.
The legacy path-first 'tps <file-or-directory> [options]' invocation remains supported.
Search subdirectories with inspect --recursive; export beside a source with legacy --csv.

result.stdout:
tps - read-only Clarion TopSpeed file inspection

Usage:
  tps <file-or-directory> [options]

Options:
  --recursive       Search subdirectories for TPS files.
  --ignore-errors   Skip damaged pages and recover readable data.
  --owner <key>     Owner key for encrypted files; may be repeated.
  --owner-env <var> Read an owner key from an environment variable; may be repeated.
  --details         Show tables, field definitions, and first-record sample values.
  --csv             Export every table and record to CSV files beside each TPS file.
  -h, --help        Show this help.

Exit codes: 0=success, 1=invalid usage/path, 2=one or more TPS files failed.

Open options:
  --owner <key>                Owner key; may be repeated.
  --owner-env <variable>       Read an owner key from an environment variable; may be repeated.
  --ignore-errors              Skip damaged pages and recover readable data.
  -h, --help                   Show command help.
Exit codes: 0=success, 1=invalid input/query, 2=parse/export failure.

result.stdout:
Usage: tps rows <file> [query-options] [open-options]
Query options:
  --table <value>              Table name or number; optional for a single-table file.
  --fields <a,b,...>           Fields/MEMOs/BLOBs to return; may be repeated.
  --where <field> <op> [value] Typed predicate; may be repeated and predicates are ANDed.
  --record <number>            Match one TPS record number.
  --skip <count>               Skip matching records (default 0).
  --limit <count>              Maximum returned records (default 100).
  --all                        Return all matching records; incompatible with --limit.
  --case-sensitive             Use case-sensitive text predicates.
  --format <json|jsonl>        Output format (default json).
  --blob-mode <metadata|base64> BLOB representation (default metadata).
Operators: eq ne lt le gt ge contains starts-with ends-with is-null is-not-null
Open options:
  --owner <key>                Owner key; may be repeated.
  --owner-env <variable>       Read an owner key from an environment variable; may be repeated.
  --ignore-errors              Skip damaged pages and recover readable data.
  -h, --help                   Show command help.
Exit codes: 0=success, 1=invalid input/query, 2=parse/export failure.

Usage: tps export <file> --output <directory> [query-options] [open-options]
Exports CSV and external BLOB files. Query options are the same as rows; export has no default limit.
  --format csv                 Export format (CSV is the only supported format).
Open options:
  --owner <key>                Owner key; may be repeated.
  --owner-env <variable>       Read an owner key from an environment variable; may be repeated.
  --ignore-errors              Skip damaged pages and recover readable data.
  -h, --help                   Show command help.
Exit codes: 0=success, 1=invalid input/query, 2=parse/export failure.
